profile.org_note: Founder-led entry-level builder run by CEO Nate Gibson under founder/managing shareholder Wade McGuinn, with a COO and three division presidents (Columbia, Greenville, Savannah/Hilton Head) since a Feb 2025 restructuring; Aiken/Augusta and Sumter were added later. Acquired by Mungo Homes (Clayton/Berkshire) in July 2026, so land and capital decisions now likely sit with Mungo/Clayton (inferred); no land or finance executive is published.
profile.summary: Columbia, SC builder founded 1985, focused on homes under $300,000 for first-time buyers and on build-to-rent sales to institutional investors (trade press says BTR has at times been most of its business). Closings rose from 337 (2023) to 581 (2024) to 993 (2025). In July 2026 Mungo Homes, a Clayton Home Building Group (Berkshire Hathaway) builder, announced it had acquired McGuinn; Mungo in turn is joining Taylor Morrison in 2027, so McGuinn is no longer an independent land-banking prospect and is reached through Clayton/Taylor Morrison.
